finding.trigger: A valid IPv6 literal proxy URL is passed to AssetStore.download.
finding.cause: URLComponents.host retains IPv6 URI brackets, which CFNetwork does not accept as a proxy host.
finding.fix: Use URL.host, which provides the IPv6 address without URI brackets, for both proxy dictionaries.

evidence: An independent URLSession probe proved bracketed host receives no proxy connection while plain host receives the exact CONNECT request.
The actual AssetStore.download red run produced two intended routing failures; all prior cases passed.
The URLComponents scheme, user/password, path, query, fragment and port checks still guard the canonical host.
The change does not touch retries, TLS, model identity or generated files.
The regression observes actual HTTP CONNECT and SOCKS5 domain/port bytes instead of inferring routing from error codes.
SOCKS5 negotiates no authentication and rejects the connect command only after receiving its full destination.
Each socket has bounded acceptance/read waits and signals completion before the listening socket is closed.
Configuration and token bytes remain unchanged and no asset is published.
gaps: Proxy stubs reject locally; no upstream TLS, sustained transfer, large-file or first-install acceptance is inferred.

evidence: One parsed canonical host is reused by the existing HTTP/SOCKS5 branches; no new networking abstraction.
The binary receive helper lives only in tests.
Sequential work, rtk-prefixed shell commands, scoped branch and retained red/probe receipts.
